comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Yes that's what I'd expect, the counts should be equal for the queries regardless of sort order or limiting, since all the rows in the table match and there are less rows in the table than the query limit.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: the original repo seems fixed, just tried the new ones - the counts are out, but there is no crashes. Looking into those

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: could be a concurrency issue (data hasn't settled on the server-side yet so you could increase the sleep after the query method acquires the lock).

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: yeah, it is concurrency indeed, test is querying too soon. I repeated queries manually and counts are good.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: i'll prep a draft PR, we will need to write a bunch of tests tomorrow and fix should be in nightly day after or we can cut a build for you?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Thanks for the quick turnaround.  We can test on `nightly` for now since our use of QuestDB isn't in production yet, and just keep this ticket posted when the fix lands into an official release.
